description: Source code for an API Gateway implemented using FastAPI. It includes health check endpoint, OAuth2 token issuance, user info retrieval, a generic proxy endpoint, and an API composition endpoint. The code integrates security, rate limiting, CORS, and backend communication.

methods.name: Dict[str,str] health_check()

methods.name: Optional[str] get_current_subject(request: Request, token: Optional[str] = Depends(oauth2_scheme))

methods.name: TokenResponse token_endpoint(credentials: TokenRequest = Body(..., embed=False))
methods.description: OAuth2 token issuance endpoint, returns a JWT token.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] me(subject: Optional[str] = Depends(get_current_subject), token: str = Depends(oauth2_scheme))
methods.description: Returns current user info and token claims.

methods.name: generic_proxy( request: Request, full_path: str, subject: Optional[str] = Depends(get_current_subject), authorization: Optional[str] = Header(default=None), )
methods.description: A proxy endpoint forwarding requests to backend services based on the path.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] composed_overview(subject: Optional[str] = Depends(get_current_subject))
methods.description: Fetches and combines data from multiple backend endpoints into a single response.
